output.title: ACME profiles extension support is for ACME issuers, none shown
output.content: The change adds support for the ACME profiles extension, which relates to ACME certificate issuance. The environment summary shows only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and only the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, so no ACME issuer configuration is visible. The excerpt does not say existing setups change behavior, so it reads as an added capability.
